notes: P05 POPETS-unit deliverable: tests/venue2027/popets/test_algorithm_properties.py — deterministic property/metamorphic/mutation tests over the REAL POPETS components, imported live and never reimplemented: revocation_model.py (allowed()/decide() -> TriDecision), candidate.py (RevocationCompleteCache dependency-closure invalidation + mechanism-isolation ablation via run_candidate), baselines.py (all four implemented arms through the real run_baseline entry point: B1 coarse-cache-purge, B2 always-recompute, purpose-bound-cache-keying, purpose-aware-cache-x06 with purpose_cache_fetch). ALL randomness is seeded deterministically (fixed random.Random(FIXED_SEED)=20271115; no time, no unseeded random, no hidden entropy; the components under test are pure with injected state). Six test families, 64 tests, all passing: (1) POSITIVE boundaries — pre-t_r ALLOW, revocation-completeness at/after t_r, stable reason codes (ALLOWED_ACTIVE_CONSENT / DENY_POST_REVOCATION), unaffected purposes stay servable, dependency-closure transitive invalidation with exact left-live set (no full flush), X06 purpose-isolation invariant 0 violations over real cache state, repeat-dispatch HIT at current epoch, exposed_bytes nonzero only on admitted dispatches. (2) NEGATIVE boundaries — parametrized malformed principal/purpose/time/item raising stable uppercase codes (PRINCIPAL_MALFORMED / PURPOSE_UNKNOWN / TIME_MALFORMED / ITEM_MALFORMED), candidate put refusals (DEPS_MALFORMED / VALUE_MALFORMED / KEY_MALFORMED / DERIVATION_PARENT_MISSING / DERIVATION_CYCLE), baseline fail-closed WORKLOAD_MALFORMED on malformed workloads in every arm, unknown baseline id returns NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL/BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE (never guessed), X06 fetch refuses cross-purpose (PURPOSE_MISMATCH), malformed keys (KEY_MALFORMED incl. bool epoch) and absent entries (CACHE_MISS). (3) UNKNOWN boundaries — INDETERMINATE is first-class and never coerced: unknown purpose strings vs known-but-unconsented purposes (PURPOSE_UNKNOWN vs PURPOSE_NOT_CONSENTED), TIME_BEFORE_GRANT, unlabelled/None lineage labels (LINEAGE_INDETERMINATE), GRANT_UNKNOWN for unknown principals, plus a fixed-seed randomized sweep (25 mixed + 30 unknown-only probes) with byte-identical re-seeded replay. (4) REVOCATION-TIMING RACES — dispatch exactly AT t_r denied boundary-inclusive in the model AND every implemented arm (REVOKED_CONTEXT), one tick before t_r still servable, earliest-covering-revocation wins multi-revocation races (specific + wildcard rows), wildcard purpose covers every purpose with stored_data='deleted' reported orthogonally, replay race: stale-epoch retry payload DENIED (DENY_EPOCH_STALE) even strictly before t_r, stale-epoch vs post-revocation denial race resolves to DENY_POST_REVOCATION, future revocation leaves earlier dispatches untouched, B1 cached-entry race: repeat dispatch of a pre-t_r cached entry after revocation stays REJECT with zero exposed bytes despite the cache-hit flag (cache hit can never resurrect revoked context), candidate idempotent re-revoke (applied=False, single log record). (5) TWO-STEP METAMORPHIC RELATIONS — MR1 purge-then-re-dispatch: B1's subject-wide purge never re-admits the revoked scope on re-dispatch (REJECT/REVOKED_CONTEXT, exposed_bytes 0); MR2 candidate purge-then-reput: put at the revoked scope refused (REVOKED_DEPENDENCY), legitimate new-epoch re-put served ONLY at the new epoch and EPOCH_STALE for the revoked one; MR3 purpose-keying epochs monotonic per scope across repeated post-revocation dispatches (0,1,2,3, rotations=3); MR4 purpose-keying monotonic under purpose change: revoking purpose 'a' rotates only the (g1,a) key space, purpose 'b' epochs stay 0 (no crosstalk); MR5 candidate vs ablation on the IDENTICAL op stream diverge exactly on the under-declared derived entry (candidate REVOKED_ENTRY / leaks=0, ablation HIT served_from_revoked_ancestry / leaks=1 leak_keys=[derived], all other read statuses equal); MR6 revocation_semantics() singleton immutable with retroactive-erasure=False and memorization always NOT_GUARANTEED; MR7 every arm byte-identical under re-invocation with different ctx seeds (no hidden randomness). (6) MUTATION-STYLE CHECKS — single-input perturbations flip the expected verdict: time across t_r (ALLOW->DENY), purpose string (DENY->ALLOW on the unaffected scope), scope mutation flips pair outcome ADMIT->REJECT in every arm, candidate epoch/purpose mutation flips HIT->EPOCH_STALE->PURPOSE_MISMATCH, dropping the revocation event flips REVOKED_ENTRY->HIT, removing a lineage label flips ALLOW->INDETERMINATE (fail-closed, never a silent DENY), granted_at mutation flips the unknown boundary, already_delivered flag never changes the verdict but attaches OUT_OF_SCOPE_PAST + NOT_GUARANTEED (no erasure claim), plus a fixed-seed 20-case mutation campaign where the unperturbed twin stays ADMIT and the scope-mutated twin is REJECT in every arm (mutation kill, no equivalent mutants). Pass gate 'Test evidence and mutation coverage' and the manifest negative gate ('Arbitrary all-deny passes correctness? assert liveness') are addressed: liveness is asserted positively (unaffected scopes HIT/ALLOW in every family, exactness left_live set, pre-t_r ALLOW) so an all-deny stub would fail at least 20 assertions.
